sensors.name: Network Neighbors LLDP
sensors.description:
Get LLDP information from the machine and return information regarding the switch it's connected to.
Those LLDP informations must have been collected by the Tanium package "Network Neighbors LLDP [Windows / Linux] 

## Format is as Follow :
## Date|Device|VLAN|Port|PortDescription|Adapter Name|Network Connection ID
Linux might not always report values from the switch because of the "disable-fw-lldp" flag, set this flag to true to disable this feature of the NIC to get the true information from the switch

queries.script:
#!/bin/sh

tanium_file="/root/.tanium-lldp.txt"

if [ -f ${tanium_file} ]; then
  cat ${tanium_file}
else
  echo "LLDP File not Found"
fi
